title: CanonicalBuilding
description: TARGET schema, not yet satisfied by anything in the codebase. See docs/architecture/02-canonical-data-model.md, migration step 3. BuildingRecord (src/types/city-domains.ts) has no propertyIds field today, and PropertySegment/LicenceRegister are ward-aggregate, not per-building - this schema is the shape those three would need to converge on for Building Entity (src/pages/governance/BuildingEntityPage.tsx) to join precisely instead of at ward level.

id.description: The canonical BuildingId. Does not exist as a concept anywhere in the codebase today - BuildingRecord.id is a per-record demo id, not a stable cross-domain key.

propertyIds.description: One building can carry several property-tax assessments (multiple flats/units). Does not exist today - PropertySegment is ward-and-segment aggregate only, with no per-parcel record for a propertyId to identify.

licenceIds.description: Trade/shop licences held against premises within this building. Does not exist today - LicenceRegister is ward-and-category aggregate only.
